relatedItems.titleZh: 迈凯伦：巴库艰难一日，全队重整旗鼓备战下一站
relatedItems.summaryZh: 迈凯伦车队官方账号发文称，在巴库度过了非常艰难的一天，车队将重整旗鼓，备战在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛。

media.altZh: 迈凯伦：巴库艰难一日，全队重整旗鼓备战下一站

relatedItems.originalTitle: A very difficult day in Baku. Time to regroup as a team for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. #McLarenF1 | #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
relatedItems.summaryEn:
A very difficult day in Baku. Time to regroup as a team for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
#McLarenF1 | #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
detailZh: 在巴库度过了非常艰难的一天。是时候作为一支车队重整旗鼓，备战在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛了。（迈凯伦车队官方账号）
detailEn:
A very difficult day in Baku. Time to regroup as a team for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
#McLarenF1 | #AzerbaijanGP 🇦🇿
keyPointsZh: 车队表示这一天非常艰难，需要作为团队重新调整状态。
下一站比赛为巴林大奖赛。
keyPointsEn: The team described the day as very difficult and said it is time to regroup as a team.
The next race mentioned is the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
